relationship_to_4WKQ_ligand: Literal gefitinib discovery series; same 4-anilinoquinazoline core with systematic C6 solvent-side-chain modifications.
title: Studies leading to the identification of ZD1839 (IRESSA): an orally active, selective epidermal growth factor receptor tyrosine kinase inhibitor targeted to the treatment of cancer.
target_and_assay: Direct human EGFR-TK assay from A431 cells; gefitinib and 27 analogues measured in one assay.
recommended_use: Strict primary benchmark and hidden SAR validation set.
reason: Best match to 4WKQ: same ligand, same scaffold family, direct EGFR endpoint, and a single internally comparable assay.

relationship_to_4WKQ_ligand: Closely scaffold-derived 4-anilinoquinazolines; replaces the gefitinib-like C6 O-linked side-chain direction with C6 carbon-linked side chains.
title: Novel 4-anilinoquinazolines with C-6 carbon-linked side chains: synthesis and structure-activity relationship of a series of potent, orally active, EGF receptor tyrosine kinase inhibitors.
target_and_assay: Biochemical EGFR inhibition at 2 uM ATP plus EGF-stimulated KB-cell antiproliferation; gefitinib is measured in both assays.
recommended_use: High-priority expansion set; analyze each assay separately and use as a broader C6-side-chain design reference.
reason: Large, experimentally measured EGFR series with gefitinib as an internal same-assay reference; close scaffold but not a literal one-bond derivative series.

relationship_to_4WKQ_ligand: Explicit gefitinib analogues that rigidify/fuse the C6/C7 solvent-region substituent into tricyclic oxazine or oxazepine systems.
title: Synthesis and biological evaluation of novel tricyclic oxazine and oxazepine fused quinazolines. Part 2: Gefitinib analogs.
target_and_assay: Cellular EGFR phosphorylation in EGF-stimulated KB cells for 14 compounds; biochemical EGFR kinase values for 9 compounds; gefitinib and erlotinib controls included.
recommended_use: Secondary pose-retention and rigidification challenge; do not combine its IC50 scale with the 2001 series.
reason: Directly named gefitinib analogue series and target-relevant, but the fused-ring changes are larger than the preferred first-round C6 terminal-group edits.

relationship_to_4WKQ_ligand: Direct replacement of gefitinib's terminal morpholine with substituted pyrrolidines.
title: Pyrrolidino Analogues of Gefitinib with Improved EGFR Inhibition, Cancer Cell Cytotoxicity, and Pharmacokinetic Properties.
target_and_assay: EGFR inhibition, A431/MDA-MB-231/A549 cytotoxicity, and pharmacokinetic profiling reported in the article.
recommended_use: Very relevant future manual extraction set, especially for terminal-ring replacement SAR.
reason: Chemically close to the editable solvent-exposed region, but a complete standardized molecule/activity table was not available in the current ChEMBL extraction.

relationship_to_4WKQ_ligand: Direct replacement of gefitinib's morpholine with substituted piperazines.
title: Optimization of gefitinib analogues with potent anticancer activity.
target_and_assay: Primarily human cancer-cell antiproliferative/cytotoxic assays; no exact direct-EGFR IC50 records were recovered under the current strict ChEMBL target query.
recommended_use: Qualitative medicinal-chemistry reference, not part of the strict quantitative EGFR benchmark.
reason: Direct gefitinib chemistry, but the available endpoints are not cleanly comparable with the 4WKQ direct-EGFR benchmark.

relationship_to_4WKQ_ligand: Three direct N-alkyl derivatives made at gefitinib's side-chain amine.
title: Synthesis of novel gefitinib-based derivatives and their anticancer activity.
target_and_assay: A549, A431 and MDA-MB-231 MTT assays plus reported EGFR inhibition studies.
recommended_use: Small supplementary set after manual verification of the exact EGFR assay table.
reason: Literal, local gefitinib edits, but only three derivatives and mixed cellular/biophysical endpoints.

relationship_to_4WKQ_ligand: Gefitinib-inspired 4-benzothienylamino quinazolines with larger core/aniline-region changes.
title: Design and synthesis of novel Gefitinib analogues with improved anti-tumor activity.
target_and_assay: Six cancer-cell lines and pan-RTK behavior; no exact direct-EGFR IC50 records were recovered under the current strict ChEMBL target query.
reason: Called gefitinib analogues but changes the scaffold more substantially and introduces multi-RTK activity.

title: Derivatives of Iressa, a specific epidermal growth factor receptor inhibitor, are powerful apoptosis inducers in PC3 prostatic cancer cells.
target_and_assay: PC3 prostate-cancer apoptosis and pharmacology rather than a clean same-assay direct EGFR series.
reason: Relevant chemistry but an unsuitable endpoint for quantitative docking/SAR benchmarking against 4WKQ.
